title: Job Record (v1)
description: A tracked job. Split in two layers, mirroring profile.schema.json: the `job-extract` agent emits the extracted fields from a scraped page dump; the app owns identity/state/provenance fields and NEVER trusts them to the agent. `description` holds the full JD prose and is the input consumed by the jd-match and resume-composer agents — it must always be populated.

status.description: App-managed lifecycle: saved | applied | interviewing | rejected | offer (see STATUS_LABELS in app.js).

link.description: App-set from the pasted/source URL. The agent never invents this.

compensation.description: Pay info if the posting states it. `raw` is the verbatim string; the rest are parsed when unambiguous.

currency.description: ISO-ish code or symbol, e.g. USD, INR, $

description.description: Full JD prose, preserved verbatim. Consumed by jd-match and resume-composer.

skills.description: Flat skill/tech keyword list — powers analytics.

apply_url.description: Distinct apply link if the page exposes one separate from `link`.

source.description: linkedin | greenhouse | lever | wellfound | bare domain.

source_url.description: Provenance: the exact URL that was scraped.

scraped_at.description: Provenance: ISO timestamp of the scrape.

extraction.description: Provenance about how this record was produced.
